name: event-bridge
description: Sends session, turn, attention and tool events to a host program over HTTP, and takes prompts and interrupts back.

url.title: Host URL
url.description: Base URL of the host's listener, such as http://127.0.0.1:47800. CLAUDE_EVENTS_URL overrides it. Empty leaves the mod idle.

token.title: Host token
token.description: Shared secret sent as a bearer token. CLAUDE_EVENTS_TOKEN overrides it. Commands from the host are accepted only when it is set.

toolDetail.title: Tool detail
toolDetail.description: summary cuts long strings in tool inputs and results to 2 KB; full sends them whole. CLAUDE_EVENTS_TOOLS overrides it.

hostPermissions.title: Host answers permission asks
hostPermissions.description: Lets the host allow or deny a tool call that would otherwise ask. Needs the token. CLAUDE_EVENTS_PERMISSIONS=host overrides it.
